Pakistan guide

Check your Binance referral status in Pakistan

Before creating an account, verify that the Binance URL contains a referral code. After login, use Binance's own referral activity page for final confirmation.

Check a referral linkCheck inside Binance

What it cannot do

This page cannot see your inviter, fee tier, cashback, or rebate status. It only helps you avoid missing referral parameters in the signup link.

Recommended steps

Confirm the URL is on binance.com and uses HTTPS.
Check whether the URL includes a referral parameter such as ref=MAXUP.
Log in to Binance and review the lower section of the official referral activity page.

Official confirmation link

Use the official Binance page after login. The displayed referral information can vary by account state and current Binance settings.

Open official referral page
Do not enter passwords, OTPs, UID, API keys, or identity documents on referral checker websites.
